bundle.shortDescription: Standard-document editing, AI-assisted research and portable presentations.
bundle.longDescription: Workbench is a local-first desktop document editor. Open standard documents, research real sources with configured services, edit chapters and media, then export Markdown, HTML, DOCX and PPTX with a portable style guide. No proprietary project format is required.
